headline: House votes down Trump impeachment resolution while Senate advances college athletes rights bill with cloture

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate rejected a cloture motion on the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act (H.R. 3633) by a vote of 49-50, failing to reach the three-fifths threshold needed. The Senate then advanced consideration of the Protect College Sports Act (S. 4668) by invoking cloture 74-24, with a unanimous consent agreement set for continued debate Wednesday morning. The chamber also confirmed Judge Matthew R. Byrne to the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Ohio.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House tabled an impeachment resolution against former President Trump by a vote of 232-147 with 47 voting present, defeating the measure. The chamber passed multiple bills under suspension of rules, including fraud prevention legislation, tax relief measures, and environmental initiatives. The House also passed a congressional resolution directing the President to remove U.S. Armed Forces from hostilities with Iran.
